targets.rawSql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT user_id, minIf(event_date, view_started > 0) AS cohort_date FROM analytics.user_day GROUP BY user_id HAVING cohort_date > toDate('1970-01-01')) SELECT toString(c.cohort_date) AS cohort, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 0) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 0))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_0, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 1) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 1))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_1, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 2) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 2))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_2, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 3) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 3))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_3, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 4) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 4))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_4, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 5) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 5))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_5, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 6) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 6))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_6, if(addDays(c.cohort_date, 7) > today(), '', concat(toString(toUInt16(round(100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(c.user_id, u.event_date = addDays(c.cohort_date, 7))) / toFloat64(uniqExact(c.user_id))))), '%')) AS day_7 FROM cohort AS c LEFT JOIN analytics.user_day AS u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.event_date >= c.cohort_date AND u.event_date <= addDays(c.cohort_date, 7) GROUP BY c.cohort_date ORDER BY c.cohort_date
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date, 'UTC') AS time, value AS dau FROM analytics.metric_points FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'dau' ORDER BY time
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date, 'UTC') AS time, value AS conversion FROM analytics.metric_points FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'conversion' ORDER BY time
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date, 'UTC') AS time, value AS avg_watch_seconds FROM analytics.metric_points FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'avg_watch_seconds' ORDER BY time

SELECT movie_id, value AS views FROM analytics.metric_points FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'top_movie_views' AND metric_date = if(length('${day}') = 10, toDate('${day}'), (SELECT metric_date FROM analytics.metric_points FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'top_movie_views' GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY sum(value) DESC, metric_date DESC LIMIT 1)) AND computed_at = (SELECT max(computed_at) FROM analytics.metric_points WHERE metric_name = 'top_movie_views' AND metric_date = if(length('${day}') = 10, toDate('${day}'), (SELECT metric_date FROM analytics.metric_points FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'top_movie_views' GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY sum(value) DESC, metric_date DESC LIMIT 1))) ORDER BY views DESC, movie_id ASC
